name: Ember-1
description: Ember-1 is Fireworks’ research-preview reasoning model built on Kimi K3 for coding and agentic workflows. It supports image input, function calling, and a 1M-token context window. Fireworks reports approximately 40% fewer generated tokens while maintaining comparable quality across its evaluations, helping reduce the cost of workloads with extensive reasoning.
